issues.label: Kaski year columns and bee-catching bag
issues.evidence: The FY 2083/84 figures are in the rightmost year column. The bee-catching bag is NPR 500.00 in the current column and NPR 509.30 in both preceding columns. Wheat foundation seed continues at the top of PDF p41. The preceding DCC schedule lists all three wheat grades together and corroborates the seven wheat and improved maize rates. The current p41 shows explicit kg units for nine certified and foundation-grade maize rows. The previous year shows the same rates across its p40–41.
issues.next: Keep the bee-catching bag and each seed rate tied to its printed year, unit and source row.

issues.label: Kaski goat manure unit
issues.evidence: The signed current row lists NPR 6.00 with a blank unit. The prior district schedule has no corresponding goat-manure row. Category-level agriculture program material leaves the exact district rate basis unverified. FY 2081/82 section 14(a) also has no equivalent goat-manure line. The provincial archive's FY 2081/82 attachment matches the earlier DAO PDF byte for byte and supplies the same historical reference.
issues.next: Find a same-district FY 2083/84 issuer clarification.

issues.label: Kaski hive-with-colony unit
issues.evidence: Both district schedules give NPR 9,500.00 for the hive with a colony and leave its unit blank. The Kaski agriculture progress report counts colony hives as sets in a separate distribution program. The pricing unit of the district entry still needs confirmation. The FY 2081/82 schedule lists an ordinary hive but gives no separate colony-hive rate. Myagdi's agriculture report counts hives with colonies as individual items for a separate cost study. The Kaski program counts sets. Neither document identifies the district price unit.
issues.next: Find an applicable written correction or issuer clarification.

issues.label: Kaski chemical fertilizer rates
issues.evidence: Section 14(b) directs users to a Government of Nepal rate. The national procedure distinguishes import-point, depot and outlet prices, and Pokhara publishes a city-specific farmer outlet price. The older city rates are also limited to Pokhara. FY 2081/82 PDF p31 uses the same national-rate cross-reference. The municipal agriculture handbook independently distinguishes historical depot bag and farmer-sale prices. The FY 2083/84 district cross-reference still lacks an identified tier.
issues.next: Obtain an applicable government or district order specifying the price tier, product and effective period for the Kaski entry.

issues.label: Kaski exact effective day
issues.evidence: The signed minutes give the approval date. The DCC portal gives Shrawan 7 as the posting date. The signed scope gives FY 2083/84. A search of the DAO and provincial rate archives returned no applicable commencement notice. The Infrastructure Development Office copy has identical page content, including the approval minutes.
issues.next: Find an issuer decision specifying the date.

issues.label: Pokhara fertilizer farmer prices at 1 km
issues.evidence: Official workbook Sheet1 B21:D21 gives NPR 19.45/kg for urea, 48.45/kg for DAP and 36.45/kg for potash. The workbook includes depot-to-outlet transport at 1 km and excludes the plastic bag.
issues.next: Use source SRC-0008 and observations RO-2494 to RO-2496 for this location and price basis.

issues.label: Pokhara fertilizer calculator per 50 kg
issues.evidence: At 1 km the three calculator amounts equal the explicitly labelled depot bag figures. Subtracting the depot price from 50 times the verified farmer per-kg price gives NPR 64.00 for each product. All 90 cached results differ by NPR 64.00–177.40. The cache's increase above the 1 km bag value follows the unscaled per-kg increase to within NPR 0.21. The workbook does not include the external sheet's formulas.
issues.next: Use the verified per-kg observations for quantity calculations. Keep the 50 kg equivalents labelled as arithmetic. A city-issued bag schedule or corrected workbook would verify the official farmer bag price.
